source_text: Cum ergo ille adhuc in praeputio testis sit fidei pronuntiatus et ob eius stipendium dilatationem fuerit seminis consecutus qua, inquit, regula tu, Iudaee, non putas ad consortium iustitiae pertinere gentiles, qui fidem Abrahae paria de Dei virtutibus credendo restituunt?
pass_a_gloss: When therefore he still in foreskin was pronounced a witness of faith and on account of its stipend obtained a dilatation of seed, by what rule, he says, do you, Jew, not think that gentiles belong to the consortium of justice, who restore the faith of Abraham by believing equal things about the virtues of God?

lemmas.lexica: LS semen; Blaise bodily seed vs transmitted sin

pass_b_english: Since, then, while still uncircumcised, Abraham was declared a witness to faith and obtained the enlargement of his offspring as faith’s reward, by what rule, Paul asks, do you, a Jew, think Gentiles do not belong to the fellowship of righteousness when they reproduce Abraham’s faith by believing the same things about God’s powers?

choices.why: Bodily seed of generation; Julian denies it carries a will's sin.
Julian's forensic virtue that renders to each his own, without fraude or gratia (partiality).
rejected: righteousness (Pauline overlay unless the verse forces it)

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
